title: Vegetable Tagine with Herby Couscous
description: A spiced vegetable tagine of aubergine, courgette, pepper, tomatoes and chickpeas, served over herby couscous.
ingredients: 400g (14oz) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
large handful of parsley leaves, finely chopped
large handful of mint leaves, finely chopped
TAGINE SPICE MIX: 2 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground coriander, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, 1 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp ground turmeric, 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper, 1/2 tsp salt
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan (400°F), Gas Mark 6. Mix together the tagine spice mix.
Spray a large, deep ovenproof dish with low-calorie cooking spray and add the onion, garlic, aubergine, courgette and pepper. Spray with more cooking spray and stir in the spice mix.
Add the chopped tomatoes, chickpeas, tomato purée, hot stock, honey and lemon juice. Stir everything together, cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes.

While the tagine is in the oven, prepare the couscous: place in a bowl, pour over the boiling water, cover with a plate and leave for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork and stir through the parsley and mint.
Season the tagine and serve on top of the couscous.
notes: For a non-vegetarian version, add diced lamb or chicken in step 2. Leftovers can be frozen.
